summary: The LLM landscape in 2024-2025 is dominated by a few frontier providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta) whose models are consumed both via direct APIs and increasingly through enterprise cloud aggregators like AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, and IBM watsonx. Open-weight families such as Meta's Llama and Mistral have surged in developer adoption via HuggingFace downloads and self-hosting, while closed frontier models retain the largest share of production API traffic. Adoption clusters tightly at the top, with a meaningful drop-off after roughly a dozen widely-deployed models.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.popularity_notes: Consistently the most-cited model in developer surveys and the default in millions of ChatGPT/API integrations, available through Azure OpenAI Service for enterprise reach.
models.best_for: General-purpose production applications and multimodal assistants

models.name: GPT-4o mini
models.popularity_notes: Extremely high API call volume as the cost-efficient default for high-throughput tasks, available via Azure OpenAI for enterprises.

models.name: Claude 3.5 Sonnet
models.popularity_notes: Leading choice for coding and agentic tasks among developers, available through AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and direct API, boosting enterprise adoption.
models.best_for: Software development, code generation, and agentic workflows

models.name: Llama 3.1 70B Instruct
models.popularity_notes: Among the most downloaded open-weight models on HuggingFace and widely self-hosted; also offered via AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI, and IBM watsonx.

models.name: Gemini 1.5 Pro
models.popularity_notes: Default frontier model on Google Vertex AI with massive enterprise reach and the largest context window, driving strong adoption.
models.best_for: Long-context document analysis and Google Cloud enterprise apps

models.name: Gemini 1.5 Flash
models.popularity_notes: High-volume cost-efficient model on Vertex AI, widely adopted for scalable production tasks with aggregator reach.
models.best_for: High-throughput, low-latency production tasks at scale

models.name: Llama 3.1 8B Instruct
models.popularity_notes: One of the most downloaded models on HuggingFace for lightweight self-hosting and fine-tuning, available across multiple aggregators.
models.best_for: Edge, on-device, and fine-tuned small-model deployments

models.name: Claude 3 Haiku
models.popularity_notes: Popular low-cost Anthropic model for high-volume tasks, widely consumed via AWS Bedrock and Vertex AI.
models.best_for: High-volume customer support and classification tasks

models.name: Mistral Large 2
models.popularity_notes: Strong European enterprise adoption, available on AWS Bedrock, Azure, and Vertex AI with solid HuggingFace presence.
models.best_for: Multilingual enterprise applications in regulated markets

models.name: GPT-3.5 Turbo
models.popularity_notes: Still heavily used in legacy production integrations due to low cost and broad tooling support, available via Azure OpenAI.

models.name: Mixtral 8x7B Instruct
models.popularity_notes: Highly downloaded open-weight mixture-of-experts model on HuggingFace, widely self-hosted and offered via Bedrock and watsonx, clustering close to #10.
